contracts: (Any case lacking a completed execution record is never marked success.) AND (Every aggregate execution terminates with output size at or below its configured finite limit.) AND (Machine-readable aggregate verdict has invalid status and acceptance_allowed=false for stale matrix evidence.) AND (The deterministic evaluator invocation returns non-success for the skipped-Consumer fixture and includes the explicit rejection reason.)
selector_intents: Execute an aggregate with a deliberately small output budget and unbounded producer; the guard must fail if output exceeds the configured limit or no terminal state is reached.
Execute the success evaluator against a deliberately skipped-Consumer fixture and assert a non-success verdict containing the skipped-Consumer diagnostic.
Present an unexecuted-case fixture to the success evaluator; the selector must produce a non-success verdict, and a green success verdict is a failure.
Select the aggregate-evaluation path with stale matrix evidence and assert that validity or acceptance is incorrectly retained.
